initial_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: Energy class C or better (A1 through C), as explicitly requested by the user.
User requires the building to be near public transport. Proximity phrasing triggers the 75th percentile threshold (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence clearly needs nearby university/school access. Proximity implied by the project type triggers the 75th percentile threshold (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The 60-bed capacity is not converted into an area filter. Energy class, public transport proximity, Turin location, and CDP/PNRR funding are outside the reference columns and are not applied here.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property type 'Uffici e assimilabili', surface_area >= 850, a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75.
